title: Manager AI/ML Engineering
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

  

We are looking for an experienced Engineering Manager \- AI/ML to lead the delivery of AI\-powered solutions across enterprise and customer\-facing platforms. This role is primarily focused on execution, Agile delivery, engineering excellence, and AI adoption, while also mentoring a high\-performing engineering team.

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Delivery \& Execution
	+ Own end\-to\-end delivery of Conversational AI Platforms(Voice/Chat)
	+ Drive Agile execution through planning, prioritization, dependency, and risk management
	+ Ensure predictable delivery, quality outcomes, and operational excellence
* Technical Leadership
	+ Lead the design and implementation of AI\-powered chatbot and voice bot solutions
	+ Drive adoption of cloud\-native architectures, CI/CD, Terraform, and Shift\-Left practices
	+ Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and compliant with enterprise standards
* AI Adoption \& Innovation
	+ Accelerate the adoption of AI across products and business processes
	+ Drive solutions leveraging Conversational AI, Generative AI, and intelligent automation
	+ Promote Responsible AI and AI Development Lifecycle (AIDLC) practices
* Stakeholder Management
	+ Partner with Product, Architecture, Security, and Business teams to deliver outcomes
	+ Manage priorities, dependencies, risks, and executive communications
	+ Align technology execution with business objectives and customer needs
* People Leadership
	+ Mentor and develop engineers and technical leads
	+ Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
	+ Support hiring, performance management, and talent development
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Experience

  


	+ 9\+ years of software engineering experience with 2\+ years in technical or people leadership roles
	+ Proven track record of delivering complex enterprise applications and programs
* Conversational AI
	+ Hands\-on experience with Amazon Lex, Google Dialogflow, and Google ADK
	+ Experience building Chatbots, Voice Bots, and Virtual Assistants
	+ Experience integrating AI solutions with CCaaS Platforms
* Engineering \& DevOps
	+ Proficiency in Python, Node.js, or TypeScript
	+ Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Terraform, and cloud\-native architectures
	+ Solid understanding of DevOps, DevSecOps, and Shift\-Left engineering practices
* AI \& Platforms
	+ Experience implementing AI solutions in enterprise environments
	+ Understanding of AIDLC and Responsible AI principles
	+ Familiarity with LLMs, RAG, and Agentic AI frameworks
* Leadership \& Delivery
	+ Solid Agile delivery experience using Scrum, Kanban etc.,
	+ Proven excellent stakeholder management and cross\-functional collaboration skills
	+ Ability to balance delivery commitments, innovation, and technical excellence

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certifications in AI/ML, Cloud, Agile, Scrum, or DevOps
* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud AI services
* Experience with Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect, Five9, or similar CCaaS platforms

 *At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone \- of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income \- deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes \- an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Parking Domain Data Scrum Master/Quality Lead
description:
Overview:

The Scrum Master \& Quality Lead will partner with our Data Product Owner (DPO)
  

and guide a cross\-functional team of software developers, data engineers, and
  

operations specialists. This team owns the end\-to\-end data lifecycle—from vehicle
  

collection and ingestion to processing, annotation, and release—powering our
  

Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Parking features (Perception, Parking
  

Functions, and Crowd\-Sourced Maps).
  

In this dual\-purpose role, you will act as a servant\-leader to optimize team workflows
  

and Agile practices, while leveraging your strong test management background to
  

establish robust validation methodologies for our data pipelines and final data
  

products. Because high\-quality data is safety\-critical for ADAS, you will champion a
  

culture where data integrity is treated with the same rigor as software code.
Responsibilities:

Key Responsibilities  

Agile Coaching \& Delivery Facilitation
  

Facilitate standard Agile ceremonies, including Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint
  

Planning, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
 Guide the team in Agile best practices, adapting frameworks
  

(Scrum/Kanban) to suit a unique blend of software engineering and
  

operational data tasks.
  

Track and communicate key delivery metrics (e.g., sprint burndown,
  

velocity, and cycle time for data processing).
  

Actively identify and remove technical or operational impediments that
  

hinder team progress.
  

2\. Partnership with the Data Product Owner (DPO)
  

Collaborate closely with the DPO to ensure the data product backlog is
  

refined, prioritized, and aligned with downstream ADAS feature
  

development.
  

Assist in breaking down complex data pipeline requirements into clear,
  

manageable epics and user stories.
  

Manage cross\-team dependencies, safeguarding the team from scope
  

creep and external distractions.
  

Data Quality \& Validation Governance
  

Champion the Definition of Done (DoD) by ensuring it explicitly
  

includes data validation gates, schema checks, and data contract
  

adherence before any story is closed.
  

Establish and monitor validation workflows for the annotation process,
  

ensuring metrics like Inter\-Annotator Agreement (IAA) and ground  

truth accuracy meet strict ADAS thresholds.
* Define statistical sampling and validation frameworks for incoming,

often noisy, crowd\-sourced parking map data.
  

Test Strategy \& Pipeline Methodology
  

Drive a "Shift\-Left" data testing culture by facilitating the integration of
  

automated data testing (e.g., anomaly detection, automated schema
  

checks) early in the ingestion and processing pipelines.
  

Coordinate with data engineers to apply robust testing methodologies
  

(Unit, Integration, and End\-to\-End) to both the pipeline code and the
  

data payloads themselves.
  

Lead defect triage sessions specifically focused on data anomalies,
  

differentiating between software pipeline defects and fundamental
  

data quality issues (e.g., sensor calibration).
  

Release Readiness \& Traceability
  

Act as the testing liaison for User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with
  

downstream ADAS feature developers, ensuring released datasets
  

physically function in their simulation and training environments.
 Ensure full traceability from initial driving campaign requirements
  

through to the final validated data release, supporting automotive
  

safety and compliance audits.
Qualifications:

Qualifications \& Skills
  

Proven experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Agile Delivery Lead in a
  

fast\-paced technology environment.
  

Deep background in Test Management, Quality Assurance, or SDET leadership,
  

with a strong grasp of modern testing frameworks and methodologies.
  

Deep understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and when to
  

pragmatically apply them.
  

Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and communication skills.
  

Proficiency with Agile lifecycle and test management tools
Essential skills:

Qualifications \& Skills
  

Proven experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Coach, or Agile Delivery Lead in a
  

fast\-paced technology environment.
  

Deep background in Test Management, Quality Assurance, or SDET leadership,
  

with a strong grasp of modern testing frameworks and methodologies.
  

Deep understanding of Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban) and when to
  

pragmatically apply them.
  

Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and communication skills.
  

Proficiency with Agile lifecycle and test management tools
Experience:

title: Scrum Master - Software
description:
**Job Description**


**Job Title:** **Scrum Master – Software**


**Overview:**



We are looking for an experienced Scrum Master – Software to facilitate Agile software development and help engineering teams deliver high\-quality, scalable software solutions. This role serves as a servant leader, Agile coach, and delivery facilitator for one or more cross\-functional software development teams. Working closely with Software Engineers, QA Engineers, DevOps Engineers, Solution Architects, Product Owners, and Engineering Managers, the Software Scrum Master ensures the successful execution of Agile ceremonies, removes delivery impediments, improves team performance, and promotes continuous improvement throughout the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).


**Roles \& responsibility:**


* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement.
* Coach teams on Scrum, Agile, and Lean practices.
* Partner with Product Owners to manage backlogs, priorities, and sprint goals.
* Track delivery progress, risks, dependencies, and impediments.
* Coordinate with Engineering, QA, DevOps, Product, and Architecture teams.
* Support release planning and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Monitor Agile metrics and improve team productivity and delivery predictability.
* Communicate project status, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.


**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience serving as a Scrum Master supporting software development teams.
* Experience delivering enterprise software, SaaS platforms, cloud\-native applications, or digital products.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development methodologies.
* Experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies for cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Excellent leadership, facilitation, coaching, and conflict resolution skills.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and communication abilities.
* Experience working in fast\-paced Agile software environments.
* Willing to work in 24/7 environment


**Preferred experience**


* CSM, PSM, PMI\-ACP, SAFe, or similar certification.
* Experience with cloud/software development environments.
* Familiarity with Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, Git, CI/CD, and cloud platforms.
* Experience working with multiple Agile teams or enterprise applications.

title: Senior Agile Coach
description:
**Company Description**  

NielsenIQ (NIQ) is a leader in data\-driven solutions, partnering with the world’s largest brands to deliver insights that drive strategic decisions. With a global presence and deep expertise in analytics and technology, we ensure that companies stay ahead in a constantly changing marketplace. Our mission extends beyond understanding consumer behaviour; it also includes refining and optimizing our internal systems that support the NIQ company operations worldwide

 **Job Description**  

Your Responsibilities

* Lead end\-to\-end Agile transformation for new ARTs / programs, from team setup through delivery stabilization and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and Data Science leadership to design scalable team structures, and operating models.
* Coach Release Train Engineers, Scrum Masters, and Product Owners to strengthen execution, flow, and outcome\-driven planning.
* Facilitate PI Planning, Inspect \& Adapt workshops, and leadership alignment sessions.
* Establish effective backlog practices, governance models, and delivery rhythms.
* Define and embed meaningful delivery metrics (flow, predictability, say/do ) to guide continuous improvement.
* Actively identify and implement AI\-enabled improvements in Agile ways of working, including automation of repetitive activities and smarter decision support.
* Coach teams and leaders on adopting AI\-supported delivery practices and experimentation culture.
* Contribute to the Agile Coaching Practice by sharing knowledge and shaping standards.

 **Qualifications**  

* Over 15 years of experience in IT, with substantial experience in software development.
* Extensive experience leading large\-scale Agile / SAFe transformations in complex enterprise environments.
* Strong expertise in SAFe, Scrum, and Kanban, including ART setup and program coaching.
* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and facilitate high\-impact workshops.
* Strong understanding of flow\-based metrics and data\-driven delivery improvement.
* Hands\-on experience with Jira Cloud, Confluence, and Miro.
* Practical understanding of AI application in software delivery, including:
	+ effective prompting techniques
	+ identifying automation opportunities in Agile processes
	+ experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar AI assistants
	+ awareness of AI capabilities in modern delivery platforms (e.g., Atlassian ecosystem)

title: Project Manager -Scrum Master - Assistant Vice President
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


**Job Summary**


We are seeking a highly motivated and results\-driven professional to perform a hybrid role of **Project Manager, and Scrum Master**. The ideal candidate will bridge business and technology teams, drive project delivery, facilitate Agile practices, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives. This role requires strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, leadership skills, and hands\-on experience in Agile project delivery.

  

  

**Responsibilities:**


**Project Manager Responsibilities**


* Lead end\-to\-end project planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery.
* Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, milestones, and success criteria.
* Develop and maintain detailed project plans and roadmaps.
* Manage project budgets, resource allocation, risks, issues, dependencies, and escalations.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including business, technology, operations, and vendors.
* Monitor project progress and provide regular status updates to stakeholders and leadership.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, quality standards, and budget.
* Facilitate decision\-making by providing project insights, metrics, and recommendations.
* Drive stakeholder engagement and manage expectations throughout project execution.
* Identify and mitigate project risks and implement corrective actions when needed.
* Ensure compliance with organizational governance, change management, and delivery frameworks.

**Scrum Master Responsibilities**


* Facilitate Agile ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand\-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Backlog Refinement sessions.
* Coach Agile teams on Scrum principles, Agile best practices, and continuous improvement.
* Remove impediments and blockers impacting team productivity and sprint commitments.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain a healthy and prioritized product backlog.
* Foster collaboration, transparency, accountability, and self\-organization within the team.
* Monitor sprint progress and ensure delivery commitments are achieved.
* Use Agile metrics such as Velocity, Burndown Charts, and Sprint Health indicators to improve team performance.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and promote Agile maturity across teams

**Recommended Qualifications:**


* 7\-10 years of experience in project manager experience.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively use complex analytical, interpretive and problem\-solving techniques
* Proven interpersonal, diplomatic and influencing skills
* Consistently demonstrate clear and concise written and verbal communication

**Professional Certifications**


* PMP (Project Management Professional) – PMI
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
* PMI\-ACP (Agile Certified Practitioner)

**Education:**


* Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience

title: Tech Lead
description:
**About NCR VOYIX**

**NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform\-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end\-to\-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Job Summary  

  

As a Senior Software Engineer at NCR VOYIX, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining complex software solutions that drive our innovative products and services. You will contribute to the full software development lifecycle, ensuring high\-quality, scalable, and secure applications.  

  

Job Responsibilities  

* Lead the design, development, testing, and deployment of robust and scalable software applications.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including product management, QA, and operations, to define requirements and deliver solutions.
* Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance and code reviews.
* Contribute to architectural discussions and decisions, ensuring alignment with overall company strategy.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, ensuring optimal system performance and reliability.
* Implement best practices in software development, including continuous integration, continuous delivery (CI/CD), and automated testing.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends, evaluating and recommending their adoption where appropriate.
* Document technical designs, specifications, and procedures clearly and concisely.

  

Job Qualifications  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 0\-2 years of professional experience in software development.
* Strong proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, C\#, Python, or Go.
* Proven experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and microservices architecture.
* Expertise in designing and implementing RESTful APIs.
* Solid understanding of database technologies (SQL and NoSQL).
* Experience with agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban).
* Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

  

This job description outlines the primary duties and responsibilities of the role and is not intended to be exhaustive. The employee may be required to undertake additional duties and projects that are consistent with their skills, capabilities, and the overall purpose of the position
